## Personally attributable Formula Dream impact

The following results belong to the Formulytics presence Lohith built and operated himself:

- 200M+ cumulative Instagram views.
- Roughly 20M Facebook views per month at peak.
- 30K Instagram followers.

These figures supersede every older partial snapshot.

Do not attribute Formula Neon main-brand account numbers to Lohith. Do not claim that automation alone caused every audience result. Safe framing connects the presence and automated operating system Lohith built and ran with the audience scale it supported.
